info.description:
Welcome to the euShipments public API documentation.

The requests to the API are HTTP GET or HTTP POST. For POST requests the body contains a JSON string; the response is always in JSON format.

API Base URLs

Environment Base URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/

Authorization

Every request must include your API token in the Authorization header, with the keyword "Bearer" before the token:

Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>

The API token is provided on request by euShipments.

How to use any web service

Web Service URL: BASE_URL + API endpoint

Example for the test environment: https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/get-countries

Example for the production environment: https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/get-countries

request.description:
We can now offer you the ability to ask for a shipment creation directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Shipment Creation".

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
createAWB Creates a new shipment according to the provided API token and the shipment's data.

Method: POST
Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

Example URLs

Environment URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/createAWB
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/createAWB

API Call Input Fields
Body (JSON)

field type required restrictions description
testMode boolean yes If you want to use the API only for tests, set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.
senderId (company id) integer yes Must be an existing company ID. ID of company, obtain an ID from Companies Web Service. Please for more information, see Companies Web Service.
courierId integer no (recommended) Must be an existing courier ID. ID of courier, obtain an ID from Couriers Web Service. If omitted, the system automatically selects the courier configured for the destination country on your account and returns an error if none is configured. We recommend always sending it explicitly.
serviceName string no Must be a service supported by the selected courier. Service name, e.g. crossborder (default) or eushipmentsairexpress. If omitted or not supported by the selected courier, the courier's first available service is used, and otherwise the system default (crossborder).
waybillAvailableDate date yes Must be between today and 9 days ahead (format YYYY-MM-DD). The date on which the shipment is to be dispatched.
responseData.id boolean no When set to true, the response also contains the internal record id of the created shipment (field id).
courierReturnAWB boolean no Request a courier return AWB together with the shipment, where the courier supports it (e.g. DHL, Zasilkovna, PPL).

recipient

Addressing: send EITHER recipient.cityId OR recipient.countryIsoCode + recipient.cityName + (recipient.zipCode OR recipient.region).

field type required restrictions description
name string yes Max 100 characters. Name of recipient or company. Typically, both customer names (first name and last name) or a company name are filled in.
cityId integer conditional Required when countryIsoCode and cityName are not sent. Must be an existing city ID. The ID of the city where the shipment needs to be delivered. Obtain an ID from the Cities resource. Please for more information, see Cities web service.
countryIsoCode string conditional Required without cityId. Two-letter uppercase ISO code, e.g. BG, RO, HU. Two-letter country ISO code of the delivery country.
cityName string conditional Required without cityId. Max 100 characters. City name. If you have your own nomenclature with cities, you can fill in the fields cityName, zipCode and region instead of cityId.
zipCode string conditional Required without cityId and region. Max 15 characters. Zip code.
region string conditional Requiered for Romania in case of sending cityName, instead of cityId. Region (county/municipality).
officeId integer no Must be an existing office ID. Delivery to a courier office / PUDO / locker: the ID of the office, obtained from Courier_Offices_Web_Service_v1.2. When officeId or officeCode is sent, streetName becomes optional.
officeCode string no Must be an existing courier office code. The courier's own office code (field COURIER_OFFICE_CODE in Courier_Offices_Web_Service_v1.2). Alternative to officeId. When either is sent, streetName becomes optional.
streetName string conditional Required unless officeId or officeCode is sent. Max 200 characters. Name of the street - e.g. Main street or Main street 10. Legacy option: office delivery can also be requested by adding the keyword "to office: " followed by the office name/address (e.g. " to office: Русе Николаевска") - this is still accepted, but we recommend using officeId or officeCode instead.
buildingNumber string or number no Values longer than 8 characters are split: the first 8 characters stay in buildingNumber and the remainder is appended to addressText. Number of the street/building - e.g. 10.
addressText string no Max 100 characters. Additional address information - e.g. bl. 25, et. 3. Not all couriers support it.
contactPerson string no Max 100 characters. Contact person. Usually the same as the name of the recipient.
phoneNumber string yes Max 100 characters. Phone number of the recipient.
email string no Not validated. Email of the recipient - highly recommended. If left empty, the system substitutes an internal placeholder address.

awb

field type required restrictions description
shipmentType string no Enum: pack, pallet Type of the shipment. Default is pack. For pallet shipments see Shipment_Creation_Web_Service_v1.5 Pallet.
parcels integer yes Min 0. Number of parcels in the shipment. Not all couriers support multi-parcel service. For pallet shipments send 0.
envelopes integer yes Min 0. Number of envelopes in the shipment. Usually 0.
pallets integer no The number of pallets (used with shipmentType = pallet).
totalWeight numeric yes Min 0.01. Total weight of the shipment in kg. The value has to be equal to the sum of all packages.
declaredValue numeric no Min 0. Insurance amount of the shipment. The service returns an error when the value is above the permitted maximum for the country. Not all couriers support the service.
bankRepayment numeric no Min 0. COD amount of the shipment in local currency. You can set it to 0 or omit it if the shipment doesn't have a COD amount.
otherRepayment string no Max 100 characters. Additional information to COD.
observations string no Max 100 characters. Additional information about the shipment/products (notes).
openPackage boolean no Check up the shipment before pay. Not supported by all couriers.
saturdayDelivery boolean no Saturday delivery. Not available for some countries.
referenceNumber string yes Max 100 characters. Must be unique to avoid duplicate shipments! Client reference number. Usually the unique number of the order from your site or an invoice number. Helps for tracking and reporting.
products string no Max 1000 characters. The content of the shipment as free text, e.g. product1 product2.
fragile boolean no Marker whether the content is fragile (fragile = 1 if the content is fragile). Used only for BG.
productsInfo string no Max 2000 characters. Additional product information.
piecesInPack integer no Products amount in one shipment, e.g. if the shipment contains 5 products the field is filled with 5.

awb.document

field type required restrictions description
type string no Enum: invoice Type of the attached document.
content base64 string no PDF content, base64 encoded.
format string no Enum: pdf Format of the attached document.

awb.packages

Optional. If awb.packages (and awb.pallets) are omitted, the system creates one package per parcel with default dimensions 10 x 10 x 20 cm, and totalWeight is spread evenly across the parcels.

field type required restrictions description
dimensions.width numeric no Min 0.1. Width of the specific parcel in cm.
dimensions.height numeric no Min 0.1. Height of the specific parcel in cm.
dimensions.length numeric no Min 0.1. Length of the specific parcel in cm.
weight numeric no Min 0.001. Weight of the specific parcel in kg.

products (top-level array)

Optional. Declares the shipment content as structured items.

field type required restrictions description
refNumber string yes Reference number of the product.
qty integer yes Min 1. Quantity of the product.
price numeric no Unit price of the product (with VAT).
priceWithoutVat numeric no Unit price of the product without VAT.

Note: for senders shipping with Econt or Speedy whose account is configured with a cash receipt, the sum of price x qty over all products must be equal to awb.bankRepayment (when the COD amount is greater than 0), otherwise the request is rejected with a validation error.

sender

Optional. Overrides the sender contact data printed on the label / sent to the courier.

field type required restrictions description
name string no Max 255 characters. Sender name.
phoneNumber string no Max 20 characters. Sender phone number.
email string no Valid email. Sender email.
econtCODAggrement string no Max 20 characters. Econt COD agreement number.

invoice

field type required restrictions description
number string no Max 30 characters. Invoice number.
issueDate date no Invoice issue date.

courierRequest

field type required restrictions description
date date string no Must be today or later. The date on which the courier must visit the address.
timeFrom time string no Format HH:MM. Starting time of the visit.
timeTo time string no Format HH:MM. End time of the visit.

customsData (legacy, non-EU destinations)

field type required restrictions description
dutyPaymentInfo string no Enum: DDU, DDP Mandatory for countries outside the European Union. DDU (Delivery duty unpaid), DDP (Delivery duty paid).
customsValue numeric no Mandatory for countries outside the European Union.

For shipments to non-EU destinations a full structured customs declaration (customs_declaration block with products and exportData) can also be sent - see Shipment_Creation_Web_Service_v1.5-NON-EU for the complete field list.

returnLabel

field type required restrictions description
nDaysValid integer no Min 0. Default 0 (no expiry). Number of days the return label is valid. For now used only for Greece.

API Response (Output Fields)

On success the service returns HTTP 200 with:

Field Description
awb AWB number.
id Internal record id of the shipment. Returned only when responseData.id is sent as true.
barcode Barcode of the shipment printed on the label.
returnLabelNumber Return label number, populated only for couriers that issue a return label as part of the create-shipment call (e.g. Geniki RR number, Zasilkovna return label). Empty for couriers that don't support it.
packagesBarcodes Barcodes of the ADDITIONAL packages only (the main label barcode is in barcode). For single-parcel shipments this is an empty array.

Example (3 parcels):

{
    "awb": 7000008793166,
    "barcode": "7000008793166001F4348",
    "returnLabelNumber": "",
    "packagesBarcodes": [
        "7000008793166002F4348",
        "7000008793166003F4348"
    ]
}

Example (single parcel):

{
    "awb": 7000008793166,
    "barcode": "7000008793166001F4348",
    "returnLabelNumber": "",
    "packagesBarcodes": []
}

On error the response body has the shape:

{
    "error": "error text"
}

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 Returns result from the web service.
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
404 Not found data.
422 Unprocessable Entity. Wrong input data.
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to ask for a shipment creation directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Shipment Creation". This page describes the creation of shipments to NON-EU destinations - the endpoint and validation are the same as Shipment_Creation_Web_Service_v1.5, plus the customs blocks described below.

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
createAWB Creates a new shipment according to the provided API token and the shipment's data.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

Example URLs

Environment URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/createAWB
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/createAWB

API Call Input Fields Body (JSON)

field type required restrictions description
testMode boolean yes If you want to use the API only for tests, set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.
senderId (company id) integer yes Must be an existing company ID. ID of company, obtain an ID from Companies Web Service. Please for more information, see Companies Web Service.
courierId integer no (recommended) Must be an existing courier ID. ID of courier, obtain an ID from Couriers Web Service. If omitted, the system automatically selects the courier configured for the destination country on your account and returns an error if none is configured. We recommend always sending it explicitly.
serviceName string no Must be a service supported by the selected courier. Service name, e.g. crossborder (default) or eushipmentsairexpress. If omitted or not supported by the selected courier, the courier's first available service is used, and otherwise the system default (crossborder).
waybillAvailableDate date yes Must be between today and 9 days ahead (format YYYY-MM-DD). The date on which the shipment is to be dispatched.
responseData.id boolean no When set to true, the response also contains the internal record id of the created shipment (field id).
courierReturnAWB boolean no Request a courier return AWB together with the shipment, where the courier supports it (e.g. DHL, Zasilkovna, PPL).

recipient

Addressing: send EITHER recipient.cityId OR recipient.countryIsoCode + recipient.cityName + (recipient.zipCode OR recipient.region).

field type required restrictions description
name string yes Max 100 characters. Name of recipient or company. Typically, both customer names (first name and last name) or a company name are filled in.
cityId integer conditional Required when countryIsoCode and cityName are not sent. Must be an existing city ID. The ID of the city where the shipment needs to be delivered. Obtain an ID from the Cities resource. Please for more information, see Cities web service.
countryIsoCode string conditional Required without cityId. Two-letter uppercase ISO code, e.g. GB, RS, CH. Two-letter country ISO code of the delivery country.
cityName string conditional Required without cityId. Max 100 characters. City name. If you have your own nomenclature with cities, you can fill in the fields cityName, zipCode and region instead of cityId.
zipCode string conditional Required without cityId and region. Max 15 characters. Zip code.
region string conditional Required without cityId and zipCode. Max 100 characters. Region (county/municipality).
officeId integer no Must be an existing office ID. Delivery to a courier office / PUDO / locker: the ID of the office, obtained from Courier_Offices_Web_Service_v1.2. When officeId or officeCode is sent, streetName becomes optional.
officeCode string no Must be an existing courier office code. The courier's own office code (field COURIER_OFFICE_CODE in Courier_Offices_Web_Service_v1.2). Alternative to officeId. When either is sent, streetName becomes optional.
streetName string conditional Required unless officeId or officeCode is sent. Max 200 characters. Name of the street - e.g. Main street or Main street 10. Legacy option: office delivery can also be requested by adding the keyword "to office: " followed by the office name/address - this is still accepted, but we recommend using officeId or officeCode instead.
buildingNumber string or number no Values longer than 8 characters are split: the first 8 characters stay in buildingNumber and the remainder is appended to addressText. Number of the street/building - e.g. 10.
addressText string no Max 100 characters. Additional address information - e.g. bl. 25, et. 3. Not all couriers support it.
contactPerson string no Max 100 characters. Contact person. Usually the same as the name of the recipient.
phoneNumber string yes Max 100 characters. Phone number of the recipient.
email string no Not validated. Email of the recipient - highly recommended. If left empty, the system substitutes an internal placeholder address.

awb

field type required restrictions description
shipmentType string no Enum: pack, pallet Type of the shipment. Default is pack.
parcels integer yes Min 0. Number of parcels in the shipment. Not all couriers support multi-parcel service.
envelopes integer yes Min 0. Number of envelopes in the shipment. Usually 0.
pallets integer no The number of pallets (used with shipmentType = pallet).
totalWeight numeric yes Min 0.01. Total weight of the shipment in kg. The value has to be equal to the sum of all packages.
declaredValue numeric no Min 0. Insurance amount of the shipment. The service returns an error when the value is above the permitted maximum for the country. Not all couriers support the service.
bankRepayment numeric no Min 0. COD amount of the shipment in local currency. You can set it to 0 or omit it if the shipment doesn't have a COD amount.
otherRepayment string no Max 100 characters. Additional information to COD.
observations string no Max 100 characters. Additional information about the shipment/products (notes).
openPackage boolean no Check up the shipment before pay. Not supported by all couriers.
saturdayDelivery boolean no Saturday delivery. Not available for some countries.
referenceNumber string yes Max 100 characters. Must be unique to avoid duplicate shipments! Client reference number. Usually the unique number of the order from your site or an invoice number. Helps for tracking and reporting.
products string no Max 1000 characters. The content of the shipment as free text, e.g. product1 product2.
fragile boolean no Marker whether the content is fragile (fragile = 1 if the content is fragile). Used only for BG.
productsInfo string no Max 2000 characters. Additional product information.
piecesInPack integer no Products amount in one shipment, e.g. if the shipment contains 5 products the field is filled with 5.

awb.document

field type required restrictions description
type string no Enum: invoice Type of the attached document.
content base64 string no PDF content, base64 encoded (e.g. the commercial invoice).
format string no Enum: pdf Format of the attached document.

awb.packages

Optional. If awb.packages (and awb.pallets) are omitted, the system creates one package per parcel with default dimensions 10 x 10 x 20 cm, and totalWeight is spread evenly across the parcels.

field type required restrictions description
dimensions.width numeric no Min 0.1. Width of the specific parcel in cm.
dimensions.height numeric no Min 0.1. Height of the specific parcel in cm.
dimensions.length numeric no Min 0.1. Length of the specific parcel in cm.
weight numeric no Min 0.001. Weight of the specific parcel in kg.

products (top-level array)

Optional. Declares the shipment content as structured items.

field type required restrictions description
refNumber string yes Reference number of the product.
qty integer yes Min 1. Quantity of the product.
price numeric no Unit price of the product (with VAT).
priceWithoutVat numeric no Unit price of the product without VAT.

Note: for senders shipping with Econt or Speedy whose account is configured with a cash receipt, the sum of price x qty over all products must be equal to awb.bankRepayment (when the COD amount is greater than 0), otherwise the request is rejected with a validation error.

sender

Optional. Overrides the sender contact data printed on the label / sent to the courier.

field type required restrictions description
name string no Max 255 characters. Sender name.
phoneNumber string no Max 20 characters. Sender phone number.
email string no Valid email. Sender email.
econtCODAggrement string no Max 20 characters. Econt COD agreement number.

invoice

field type required restrictions description
number string no Max 30 characters. Invoice number.
issueDate date no Invoice issue date.

courierRequest

field type required restrictions description
date date string no Must be today or later. The date on which the courier must visit the address.
timeFrom time string no Format HH:MM. Starting time of the visit.
timeTo time string no Format HH:MM. End time of the visit.

customs_declaration (structured customs declaration - recommended for non-EU destinations)

Optional block. When sent, all of its required sub-fields must be present. The declaration is stored together with the shipment and used for the export documents.

customs_declaration.products (array, at least 1 item)

field type required restrictions description
description string yes Max 255 characters. Description of the goods on this line.
taric string yes Max 10 characters. TARIC / HS commodity code of the goods.
base_value numeric yes Min 0.01. Customs value of this line.
quantity integer yes Min 1. Quantity of the goods on this line.
weight integer yes Min 1. Weight of the goods on this line.
country_of_origin string yes Two-letter uppercase ISO code. Country of origin of the goods.
client_ref string yes Max 100 characters. Your reference for this product line.

customs_declaration.exportData

field type required restrictions description
country_of_export string yes Two-letter uppercase ISO code. Country from which the goods are exported.
declaration_country string yes Two-letter uppercase ISO code. Country in which the customs declaration is lodged.
ioss_number string conditional Max 15 characters. Required whenever customs_declaration is sent, except for courier 805 where it is optional. IOSS number of the seller.

If the customs_declaration data fails validation after the shipment is created, the API responds with HTTP 422 and an error message, so always check the response.

customsData (legacy customs block - still accepted)

field type required restrictions description
dutyPaymentInfo string no Enum: DDU, DDP Mandatory for countries outside the European Union. DDU (Delivery duty unpaid), DDP (Delivery duty paid).
customsValue numeric no Mandatory for countries outside the European Union.

returnLabel

field type required restrictions description
nDaysValid integer no Min 0. Default 0 (no expiry). Number of days the return label is valid. For now used only for Greece.

API Response (Output Fields)

On success the service returns HTTP 200 with:

Field Description
awb AWB number.
id Internal record id of the shipment. Returned only when responseData.id is sent as true.
barcode Barcode of the shipment printed on the label.
returnLabelNumber Return label number, populated only for couriers that issue a return label as part of the create-shipment call (e.g. Geniki RR number, Zasilkovna return label). Empty for couriers that don't support it.
packagesBarcodes Barcodes of the ADDITIONAL packages only (the main label barcode is in barcode). For single-parcel shipments this is an empty array.

Example:

{
    "awb": "1507023066",
    "barcode": "1507023066001",
    "returnLabelNumber": "",
    "packagesBarcodes": []
}

On error the response body has the shape:

{
    "error": "error text"
}

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 Returns result from the web service.
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
404 Not found data.
422 Unprocessable Entity. Wrong input data.
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to create a pickup request for a shipment directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Pickup AWB Creation".

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
/awb/pickup Creating a pickup AWB in our system via API.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

Example URLs

Environment URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/awb/pickup
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/awb/pickup

API Call Input Fields Body (JSON)

field type required restrictions description
companyId integer yes There must be a company with the selected ID. ID of company, you can receive it from the Companies Web Service.
courierId integer yes There must be a courier with the selected ID. ID of courier, you can receive it from the Couriers Web Service. Always required for pickup AWBs.

sender

Addressing: send EITHER sender.cityId OR sender.countryIsoCode + sender.cityName + (sender.zipCode OR sender.region).

field type required restrictions description
name string yes Max 100 characters. Name of sender or company. Typically, both sender names (first name and last name) or a company name are filled in.
cityId integer conditional Required when countryIsoCode and cityName are not sent. Must be an existing city ID. The ID of the city from which the shipment will be picked up. Obtain an ID from the Cities resource. Please for more information, see Cities web service.
countryIsoCode string conditional Required without cityId. Two-letter uppercase ISO code, e.g. BG, HU. Two-letter country ISO code of the pickup country.
cityName string conditional Required without cityId. Max 100 characters. Sender's city name, e.g. Sofia.
zipCode string conditional Required without cityId and region. Max 15 characters. Sender's city zip code, e.g. 1000.
region string conditional Required without cityId and zipCode. Max 100 characters. Recommended for Romania. Sender's region.
officeId integer no Must be an existing office ID. Pickup from a courier office / PUDO: the ID of the office from Courier_Offices_Web_Service_v1.2. When officeId or officeCode is sent, streetName becomes optional.
officeCode string no Must be an existing courier office code. The courier's own office code. Alternative to officeId. When either is sent, streetName becomes optional.
streetName string conditional Required unless officeId or officeCode is sent. Max 200 characters. Name of the street of the pickup address - e.g. Main street or Main street 10.
contactPerson string no Max 100 characters. Contact person. Usually the same as the name of the sender.
phoneNumber string yes Max 100 characters. Sender's phone number.
email string yes Must be a valid email address. Sender's email.

awb

field type required restrictions description
parcels integer yes Must be exactly 1. Number of parcels in the pickup shipment. Only single-parcel pickups are supported.
totalWeight numeric yes Min 0.01. Total weight of the shipment in kg.
observations string no Max 100 characters. Additional information about the shipment/products (notes).
referenceNumber string yes Max 100 characters. Must be unique! Client reference number. Usually the unique number of the pickup request from your system. Helps for tracking and reporting.
products string no Max 1000 characters. The content of the shipment, e.g. product1 product2.

awb.packages

Optional array.

field type required restrictions description
dimensions.width numeric no Min 0.1. Package width in cm.
dimensions.height numeric no Min 0.1. Package height in cm.
dimensions.length numeric no Min 0.1. Package length in cm.
weight numeric no Min 0.001. Package weight in kg.

API Response (Output Fields)

On success the service returns HTTP 200 with:

Field Description
pickupAWBNumber Pickup AWB number.
id Internal record id of the pickup AWB.
lockerCode The courier's pickup-order / locker code, or null when not applicable.

Example:

{
    "pickupAWBNumber": "3169951776",
    "id": 12345678,
    "lockerCode": null
}

Important: most runtime errors (courier rejection, duplicate reference number, partner API not responding, etc.) are returned with HTTP 200 and a body of the shape below. Always check the response body for an "error" key, even when the HTTP status is 200.

{
    "error": "error text"
}

Validation failures return HTTP 422.

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 Returns result from the web service - either the created pickup AWB or an error object (check for the "error" key).
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
404 Not found record.
422 Unprocessable Entity. Wrong input data.
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to ask for a shipping label directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "PDF Web Service".

Requirements:

API Endpoint Description
print/{AWBnumber} Get the shipping label as a PDF file (A4 or label format, base64 encoded) or as a raw ZPL string.

Method: GET Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

API Call Input Fields URL query parameters

field type required restrictions description
testMode boolean yes If you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.
printFileType smallInt no Allowed values: 1, 2, 3. Default: 2 Choose the print format:
1 = PDF in A4 format;
2 = PDF in label format (default when the parameter is omitted);
3 = raw ZPL (Zebra Programming Language) label.
A4/label formats work only if the courier also supports the waybill in both formats. Important: if a specific label type is configured for your account in our system, you receive the PDF in the format configured in our system.
ZPL (printFileType=3) is available only for couriers that provide a ZPL label; for all other couriers the service returns an error.

Notes:

  • For multi-parcel shipments only the label of the MAIN package can be requested. Requesting the AWB number of a secondary parcel returns HTTP 422 with the error "Additional package detected. Please print the main package instead."
  • If the number you pass is an InOut pre-AWB label number (an InOut label created before the courier AWB exists), the InOut label is returned instead of a courier label.

Example URLs:

Test: https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/print/64506083?testMode=1 Production: https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/print/64506083?testMode=0

API Response (Output Fields)

Field Description
type Document type: "PDF" or "ZPL".
awb_print For type "PDF" - the base64 encoded PDF file. For type "ZPL" - the raw ZPL string (not base64 encoded).

Example (PDF):

{
    "type": "PDF",
    "awb_print": "JVBERi0xLjQKJ... (base64 encoded PDF)"
}

Example (ZPL, printFileType=3):

{
    "type": "ZPL",
    "awb_print": "^XA^CI28... (raw ZPL string)"
}

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 Returns result from the web service.
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
404 Not found data.
408 The partner API did not answer. Please try again later!
422 Unprocessable Entity. Wrong input data. / Additional package detected. Please print the main package instead. / ZPL not available for this courier.
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to get the statuses history for a list of AWB numbers directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Waybills History Web Service".

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
/fulfilment/waybills-history Receive the statuses history for up to 100 AWB numbers in one request. The lookup is strictly BY AWB NUMBER (the shipment number returned at AWB creation), not by order reference number.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

API Call Input Fields Body (JSON)

field type required restrictions description
testMode boolean yes If you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.
awbs array of objects yes max 100 AWB's per request List of the AWB numbers you want to check.
awb string yes Must exist in our DB and must be created with your API Token Shipment number (AWB).

Example:

{
    "testMode": 0,
    "awbs": [
        {
            "awb": "321654987456"
        },
        {
            "awb": "321654123456"
        },
        {
            "awb": "987654321"
        },
        {
            "awb": "654321897654"
        }
    ]
}

Example URLs:

Test: https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/waybills-history Production: https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/waybills-history

API Response (Output Fields)

The service returns an array with one entry per requested AWB, in the same order as the request.

Field Description
refNum Your order reference number - the value you sent in "referenceNumber" when the AWB was created. Null in not-found entries.
awb The AWB number from your request.
newReturnNumber The return AWB number, if a return shipment was generated for this AWB. Null if no return shipment exists.
courierId The ID of the last-mile courier delivering the shipment.
courierName The name of the last-mile courier delivering the shipment.
error Text of a possible error for this AWB (e.g. AWB not found or not accessible with your API token). Null when the AWB was found.
errorCode Error code for this AWB, if any (e.g. 404 when the AWB was not found). Null when the AWB was found.
statusesHistory Array with the statuses history. Empty array when the AWB was not found.

StatusesHistory (Data Structure)

Field Description
ID Record identifier.
STATUS Status text (e.g. In transit, On delivery etc.).
DATE The moment the status occurred at the courier (courier event time). The history is ordered by this field.
DATE_CREATED The date when the record was stored in the euShipments system.
COMMENT The name of the status in the native language for every country.

We can now offer you the ability to ask for the last shipment status directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Shipment Status Web Service".

Requirements:

API Endpoint Description
get-status/{AWBNumber} Receive the last shipment status.

Method: GET Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

API Call Input Fields URL query parameters

field type required restrictions description
testMode boolean yes If you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.

Test: https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/get-status/64506083?testMode=1 Production: https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/get-status/64506083?testMode=0

API Response (Output Fields)

Field Description
status Text with the last status from the shipment tracking.

Example:

{
    "status": "Delivered"
}

Special value: if the AWB has been deleted/cancelled in our system, the service still responds with HTTP 200 and returns:

{
    "status": "canceled/deleted"
}

We can now offer you the ability to ask for the full shipment history directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Shipment History Web Service".

Requirements:

width numeric no 0 - 999 Package width in cm. Used where dimensional pricing applies.
height numeric no 0 - 999 Package height in cm. Used where dimensional pricing applies.
city string no Ignored Accepted but IGNORED by the price calculation. Kept only for backward compatibility.

request.description:
We can now offer you the ability to ask order creation from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Order Creation Web Service".

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
/fulfilment/create-order Creating a order in our fulfilment system.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN Body (JSON)

Example URLs:

Environment URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/create-order
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/create-order

Important!!! You can upload orders only if the products from the orders are available (there is enough stock) in euShipments warehouse.

API Call Input Fields

parameter type required restrictions description
testMode bool yes if you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.
senderId integer yes There must be a company with the selected ID. ID of company, you can receive it from the „Companies Web Service".
courierId integer no There must be a courier with the selected ID. ID of courier, you can receive it from the „Couriers Web Service". If the field is omitted, the courier is assigned automatically by euShipments.
waybillAvailableDate date yes From today up to 9 days ahead. Cannot be in the past and cannot be more than 9 days in the future. Date when the order should be processed.
serviceName string no Must be an existing service name and must be offered by the selected courier. The service name must be one of the following:
• crossborder
• eushipmentsairexpress
• eushipmentsglobal economy
• eushipmentsglobal premium
If the parameter is not present, the service is resolved automatically: the first service configured for the selected courier, otherwise the system default (crossborder).
warehouseInfo boolean no If set to true, the response also contains a warehouse object (see API Response below) with the name and country of the warehouse that will fulfil the order.
recipient object yes
name string yes MaxLength: 100 Name of recipient or company. Typically, both customer names (first name and last name) or company name are filled in.
cityId integer no The parameter is mandatory if city and country data are not filled in. There must be a city with the selected ID. The ID of a city where the shipment needs to delivery. Obtain an ID from Cities resource. Please for more information, see Cities web service.
countryIsoCode string no Mandatory whenever recipient.cityId is not sent. Uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. BG, RO, HU). Must be an existing country. Country ISO code.
cityName string no Required field if city ID is not present. MaxLength: 100 Recipient's city name e.g. Sofia.
zipCode string no Required field if neither city ID nor region is present. MaxLength: 15 Recipient's city zip code e.g. 1000.
region string no Required for Romania. Required field if neither city ID nor zip code is present. MaxLength: 100 Recipient's region e.g. София.
officeId integer no There must be an office with the selected ID. Obtain an ID from City offices or Courier offices resource. Please see one of the two web services for more information. When sent, the shipment is created to the office and streetName is not required.
officeCode string no There must be an office with the selected code. Obtain a COURIER OFFICE CODE from City offices or Courier offices resource. Please see one of the two web services for more information. When sent, the shipment is created to the office and streetName is not required.
streetName string yes* Required unless recipient.officeId or recipient.officeCode is sent. MaxLength: 200 name of the street, office address or office name - e.g. If you create a shipment to address - Main street or Main street 10. If you want to create a shipment to an office and not use the "officeId" or "officeCode", please add a keyword "to office: " to office name or office address (obtain information from "offices address" web service.) e.g. " to office: Русе Николаевска" or " to office: Русе ж.к. ЦЮР ул. Николаевска №109".
buildingNumber string or number no MaxLength: 100 Number of the street/building - e.g. 10. If the value is longer than 8 characters, only the first 8 characters are kept as building number and the rest is automatically appended to addressText after a "|" separator.
addressText string no MaxLength: 300 (values longer than 100 characters are truncated to 100 when the order is stored) Additional address information – e.g. бл.25 вх.1 ет.3 ап.4 or bl.25 vh.1 et.3 ap.4 or another information for the address.
contactPerson string no MaxLength: 100 Contact person. Usually is the same as the name of recipient.
phoneNumber string yes MaxLength: 100 Recipient's phone number. Required (a few country-specific exceptions exist where a default number is applied).
email string no Not validated. Recipient's email.
awb object yes
parcels integer yes Min: 0 Number of parcels in the shipment.
envelopes integer yes Min: 0 Number of envelopes in the shipment. The field is required but may be 0.
totalWeight numeric yes Min: 0.01 Total weight of the shipment in kg.
declaredValue numeric no Min: 0 Insurance amount of the shipment.
bankRepayment numeric no Min: 0 COD amount of the shipment. You can set to 0 if the shipment doesn't have a COD amount.
otherRepayment string no MaxLength: 100 Additional information to COD.
observations string no MaxLength: 300 Additional information about the shipment/products. (notes)
openPackage boolean no Check up the shipment before pay. Not available for all countries.
shipmentPayer string no ENUM: sender, recipient Who pays the shipment. Any other value is rejected with HTTP 400 and the message "The recipient.shipmentPayer text must be sender or recipient.".
saturdayDelivery boolean no Saturday delivery. Not available for some countries.
referenceNumber string yes MaxLength: 100 Client reference number. Usually, the client put here the unique number of order from the site or unique order number of the content or invoice number. Helps for tracking and reporting.
Important: The information in the field must be unique to avoid duplicate shipments!
referenceNumberDate date no Date of the client order (reference number).
products string no MaxLength: 1000 The content of the shipment. e.g. product1 product2.
fragile boolean no Marker whether the content is fragile. (fragile = 1 if the content is fragile)
productsInfo string no MaxLength: 2000 Аdditional product information.
piecesInPack integer no Products amount in one shipment. e.g If the shipment contain 5 products the field will be filled with 5.
packages array of objects no Physical packages of the shipment. Each element contains dimensions and weight (see below).
packages.*.dimensions.width numeric no Min: 0.1 Package width in cm.
packages.*.dimensions.height numeric no Min: 0.1 Package height in cm.
packages.*.dimensions.length numeric no Min: 0.1 Package length in cm.
packages.*.weight numeric no Min: 0.001 Package weight in kg.
document object no A document attached to the shipment.
document.type string no ENUM: invoice Type of the document.
document.content string no The document content as a base64 encoded string.
document.format string no ENUM: pdf Format of the document.
products Array of objects no The content of the shipment, described as individual products. Not enforced by the API as required, but you should send either products or boxes so the order has a documented content.
refNumber string yes Product reference number. That is your product code or barcode.
qty integer yes Min: 1 Product quantity.
price numeric no Unit price of the product (with VAT).
Important: for senders with a cash-receipt configuration for Econt or Speedy, the sum of price × qty over all product lines must equal awb.bankRepayment, otherwise the order is rejected.
priceWithoutVat numeric no Unit price of the product without VAT.
boxes Array of objects no Alternative to the flat products array – products grouped in boxes.
refNumberBox string yes Reference number of the box. Required for every box element.
items Array of objects yes Min: 1 element Products in the box. Each item contains refNumber (string, required), qty (integer, required, min 1), price (numeric, optional) and priceWithoutVat (numeric, optional) with the same meaning as in the products array.
courierRequest object no Courier pickup request.
courierRequest.date date no Today or later. Date of the courier pickup request.
courierRequest.timeFrom time no Format: H:i Earliest pickup time.
courierRequest.timeTo time no Format: H:i Latest pickup time.
returnLabel object no
returnLabel.nDaysValid numeric no Min: 0 Number of days the return label is valid.
courierReturnAWB boolean no If set to true, a courier return AWB is created for the shipment.
sender object no Sender contact data override.
sender.name string no MaxLength: 255 Sender name.
sender.phoneNumber string no MaxLength: 20 Sender phone number.
sender.email email no Sender email.
sender.econtCODAggrement string no MaxLength: 20 Econt COD agreement number.
invoice object no
invoice.number string no MaxLength: 30 Invoice number.
invoice.issueDate date no Invoice issue date.
customsData object no
dutyPaymentInfo string no Mandatory field for countries outside the European Union.
ENUM: DDU (Delivery duty unpaid), DDP (Delivery duty paid)		 dutyPaymentInfo
customsValue numeric 15.2 no Mandatory field for countries outside the European Union. customsValue
customs_declaration object no Customs declaration data for non-EU destinations. When the block is present, its products and exportData parts are required.
customs_declaration.products Array of objects yes* Min: 1 element. Required when customs_declaration is present. Declared products.
customs_declaration.products.*.description string yes MaxLength: 255 Product description.
customs_declaration.products.*.taric string yes MaxLength: 10 TARIC code.
customs_declaration.products.*.base_value numeric yes Min: 0.01 Declared value of the product.
customs_declaration.products.*.quantity integer yes Min: 1 Declared quantity.
customs_declaration.products.*.weight integer yes Min: 1 Declared weight.
customs_declaration.products.*.country_of_origin string yes Uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Country of origin.
customs_declaration.products.*.client_ref string yes MaxLength: 100 Client reference of the product.
customs_declaration.exportData object yes* Required when customs_declaration is present. Export data.
customs_declaration.exportData.country_of_export string yes Uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Country of export.
customs_declaration.exportData.declaration_country string yes Uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Country where the declaration is submitted.
customs_declaration.exportData.ioss_number string yes* MaxLength: 15. Required when customs_declaration is present (optional for some couriers). IOSS number.

API Response (Output Fields)

Field Description
orderId ID of order.
code HTTP status code.
error A field that contains the text from a possible error while executing the web service from the server-side.
warehouse Returned only when warehouseInfo = true is sent. Object with name and country of the warehouse that will fulfil the order (null on error).

Example:

{
    "orderId": 745770,
    "error": false,
    "code": 200
}

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 The order created successfully.
400 Bad request. Returned also for an invalid awb.shipmentPayer value: "The recipient.shipmentPayer text must be sender or recipient."
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
404 Not found record.
422 Wrong params.
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to attach PDF file (invoice) from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Attach PDF Files Web Service".

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
/fulfilment/attach-pdf-files You can attach files to your order.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN Body (JSON)

Example URLs:

Environment URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/attach-pdf-files
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/attach-pdf-files

Important!!! Files can be attached only before the AWB is generated for the order. Once the order already has an AWB, the order is no longer found by this service and the request returns HTTP 422 (see below). Pre-AWB orders are also rejected with the error "For specified order, you can not add documents!".

API Call Input Fields

parameter type required restrictions description
testMode bool yes if you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.
orderId integer no Required if the reference number not present. ID of order.
referenceNumber string no MaxLength: 100 Reference number (usually the reference number is the order number from your system.)
files array yes Max: 1 element per request. Array with the files to attach. To attach more than one file, send a separate request for each file.
base64Attached string yes The decoded content must be a real PDF file (the file signature is validated). If the content is not a PDF, the request fails with "The file must be in pdf format!". The base64 formatted string.

Example (request body):

{
  "testMode": false,
  "orderId": null,
  "referenceNumber": "0000026",
  "files": [
    {
      "base64Attached": "base64 string"
    }
  ]
}

API Response (Output Fields)

The response is always a JSON array with one object per processed file:

Field Description
error false on success, or the text of the error while executing the web service from the server-side.
orderId ID of order.
referenceNumber Client reference number. (order number, invoice number or other unique number)
pdfId The ID for your attached pdf (null on error).
pdfCode The code for your attached pdf (null on error).
code HTTP status code for this file.

Example (success):

[
  {
    "error": false,
    "orderId": 745770,
    "referenceNumber": "0000026",
    "pdfId": 1024,
    "pdfCode": "5420122-333-1",
    "code": 200
  }
]

Example (order not found — returned with HTTP status 422):

[
  {
    "error": "Not found order with the specified number!",
    "orderId": 123,
    "referenceNumber": "0000026",
    "pdfId": null,
    "pdfCode": null,
    "code": 422
  }
]

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 The pdf files added successfully.
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
422 Wrong params / Not found order with the specified number (the order does not exist, is not yours, or already has a generated AWB).
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized. Returned also when the file content is not a valid PDF ("The file must be in pdf format!") and when documents cannot be added to the specified order ("For specified order, you can not add documents!").

We can now offer you the ability to ask product creation from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Product Creation Web Service".

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
/fulfilment/create-product Creating a product in our fulfilment system.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN Body (JSON)

Example URLs:

Environment URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/create-product
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/create-product

API Call Input Fields

parameter type required restrictions description
testMode bool yes if you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.
companyId integer yes ID of company, you can receive it from the „Companies Web Service".
product object yes
name string yes MaxLength: 200 Product name.
barcode string yes MaxLength: 50 Product barcode e.g - 5439636114211.
refNumber string yes MaxLength: 100 Product reference number.
description text no MaxLength: 500 Product description.
length numeric(15.2) yes Min: 0.1, Max: 999 Product length in cm.
width numeric(15.2) yes Min: 0.1, Max: 999 Product width in cm.
height numeric(15.2) yes Min: 0.1, Max: 999 Product height in cm.
weight numeric(15.2) yes Min: 0.01, Max: 999 Product weight in kg.
hsCode string no HS Code. Stored as sent; not validated by the application.

Important! The barcode is checked across our entire system, not only among your own products. If the barcode you send is already used by another product (any company), the request is rejected with a 422 error (see below) and no product is created. The reference number (refNumber), on the other hand, is checked only within your own company: sending a refNumber that already exists for your company is also rejected with a 422 error, so resending the same create-product request never creates a duplicate product for the same company. In the rare case a barcode passes the initial uniqueness check but still collides at database level (e.g. a race condition), the product is created anyway, just without a barcode attached.

Example:

{
    "testMode": true,
    "companyId": 332,
    "product": {
        "name": "test product",
        "barcode": "bb-test-54202",
        "refNumber": "ref-test-54202",
        "description": "test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test decsription test",
        "length": 20.5,
        "width": 20.5,
        "height": 20.5,
        "weight": 2.2,
        "hsCode": "640399.30.00"
    }
}

API Response (Output Fields)

Field Description
productId ID of the created product (null on error).
error false on success, or the text of the error while executing the web service from the server-side.

Example:

{
  "productId": 85,
  "error": false
}

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
201 The product was created successfully.
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
422 Wrong params, or duplicate barcode: {"productId": null, "error": "This barcode is not unique for our system: ()"}, or duplicate reference number: {"productId": null, "error": "The product with reference number already exists. The reference number must be a unique value."}
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to create a booking request from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Booking Request Creation Web Service".

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
/fulfilment/create-request Creating a booking request in our fulfilment system.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN Body (JSON)

Example URLs:

Environment URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/create-request
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/create-request

Changelog

Version Change
v1.1 (October 2026) Added optional client reference fields: clientReference, ref1, ref2, ref3. They are stored with the booking request and returned verbatim by the "Request Status Web Service" and the "Booking Request Status Web Service". Existing integrations are not affected.

API Call Input Fields

parameter type required restrictions description
testMode bool yes if you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.
companyId integer yes ID of company, you can receive it from the „Companies Web Service".
warehouseId integer yes ID of warehouse you want to send a Request to. Your company must have access to this warehouse.
courierInc string no MaxLength: 50. If sent, cannot be empty. Incoming courier name. Empty string is rejected with "Courier name is invalid".
trackNumb string no MaxLength: 50. If sent, cannot be empty. Incoming tracking number. Empty string is rejected with "Tracking number is invalid".
deliveryDate date no Format: Y-m-d. Today or later. Expected delivery date of the incoming shipment.
packagesCount integer no Min: 1. If sent, cannot be empty/0. Number of packages of the incoming shipment. 0 or empty is rejected with "Package count is invalid".
clientReference string no MaxLength: 100. Printable ASCII only. Your own primary identifier of the booking request (e.g. your purchase order / inbound document number). Stored as received and returned by both status services.
ref1 string no MaxLength: 100. Printable ASCII only. Free-text reference 1. No meaning on our side; stored as received and returned by both status services.
ref2 string no MaxLength: 100. Printable ASCII only. Free-text reference 2. Same rules as ref1.
ref3 string no MaxLength: 100. Printable ASCII only. Free-text reference 3. Same rules as ref1.
products Array of objects yes Min: 1 element. Products included in the Request.
refNumber string yes Reference number of the product. Must be a product that already belongs to your company.
quantity integer yes Min: 1 Product quantity.

Client reference fields (clientReference, ref1, ref2, ref3) - rules

  • Optional. If the key is omitted, sent as null or sent as an empty string, the value is stored as null and returned as null.
  • Printable ASCII only (space to ~: letters, digits, punctuation). Accented or Cyrillic characters, tabs, line breaks and emoji are rejected with HTTP 400: "The ref1 may contain only printable ASCII characters (letters, digits, punctuation)."
  • Longer than 100 characters, or not a string (number, array, object), is rejected with HTTP 400, e.g. "The ref1 may not be greater than 100 characters."
  • Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before storing.
  • Stored once at creation. They cannot be changed afterwards through the API.
  • Not searchable and not unique: there is no lookup by clientReference, and two booking requests may carry the same value.
  • Not shown in the client cabinet; they are available only through the API status services.

Important! If the same refNumber appears more than once in the products array, the duplicate lines are merged into a single line and their quantities are summed.

Example:

{
    "testMode": true,
    "companyId": 332,
    "warehouseId": 1,
    "courierInc": "DHL",
    "trackNumb": "1234567890",
    "deliveryDate": "2026-10-20",
    "packagesCount": 3,
    "clientReference": "PO-2026-0042",
    "ref1": "Supplier: ACME GmbH",
    "ref2": "Dock 3",
    "ref3": null,
    "products": [
        {
            "refNumber": "ref-test-54202",
            "quantity": 10
        },
        {
            "refNumber": "ref-test-54201",
            "quantity": 100
        }
    ]
}

API Response (Output Fields)

Field Description
requestId ID of the created Request.
error A field that contains the text from a possible error while executing the web service from the server-side.

Example:

{
    "requestId": 137
}

Related services: Once you have a requestId, you can check it with the "Request Status Web Service" (GET /api/v1/fulfilment/get-request-status/{id}) or receive the full lifecycle and product breakdown with the "Booking Request Status Web Service" (POST /api/v1/fulfilment/booking-request-status). Both return the clientReference, ref1, ref2 and ref3 values exactly as you sent them.

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
201 The Request was created successfully.
400 Bad request / validation error, e.g. "The ref1 may not be greater than 100 characters." or "The ref1 may contain only printable ASCII characters (letters, digits, punctuation)."
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
422 Wrong params, or one of the following: "Courier name is invalid" / "Tracking number is invalid" / "Package count is invalid" / "The company ID you added in Request does not exist. Please check it!" / "You don't have access to this warehouse. Please check warehouseId in your Request!" / "The selected products reference numbers is invalid. Please check following Product's Ref Numbers: " / "Error when saving Request information!"
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to create a warehouse transfer protocol from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Transfer Creation Web Service".

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
/fulfilment/create-transfer Creating a warehouse transfer protocol (stock movement between two warehouses, or a scrap protocol) in our fulfilment system.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN Body (JSON)

Example URLs:

Environment URL
Test https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/create-transfer
Production https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/fulfilment/create-transfer

API Call Input Fields

parameter type required restrictions description
testMode bool yes if you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all transfers save on test env. true validates the whole payload end-to-end and persists nothing.
companyId integer yes ID of company, you can receive it from the „Companies Web Service". Must be accessible to your token (partner/cabinet scope; admin tokens may use any).
sourceWarehouseId integer yes ID of the sending warehouse. You can receive it from the „Warehouses List Web Service" (field data[].id).
destinationWarehouseId integer no ID of the receiving warehouse, you can receive it from the „Warehouses List Web Service" (field data[].id). If sent, must differ from sourceWarehouseId, otherwise rejected.
protocolType integer no Default: 1 1 = NORMAL, 3 = SCRAP. 2 (EMAG/Skroutz) is admin-only; requested by a non-admin token it is rejected with PROTOCOL_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.
needCheck bool no Requires scanning in the warehouse.
comments string no Free-text note.
receiver string no Receiver text (store unit).
waybill string no Waybill number.
instructions string no Free-text instructions.
externalRef string yes MaxLength: 100 Idempotency key, unique per companyId. Required for the API only (manual/UI/Excel-import transfers don't use it) — see Important notes below.
items Array of objects yes Min: 1 element. Transfer lines.
refNumber string one of refNumber/barcode Product reference number.
barcode string one of refNumber/barcode Product barcode. If both refNumber and barcode are sent, refNumber is used to resolve the product (barcode is ignored) — identical to the Excel-import behaviour.
quantity integer yes Min: 1 Non-positive or non-integer values are rejected as INVALID_QUANTITY.
batchNo string with batchDate Batch number. Must be sent together with batchDate (or neither) — one without the other is rejected as BATCH_INCOMPLETE.
batchDate date with batchNo Format: YYYY-MM-DD Batch date.

Important! The protocol date is never taken from the request — the server always sets it to today's date. Every row is validated (product belongs to the company, item-level stock, per-batch stock) before anything is written — if any single row fails, nothing is persisted (all-or-nothing). The starting status of the protocol depends on your token's access type: cabinet/client tokens start it at STATUS_CABINET_WAITING (skipping the UI draft step, since the API sends a complete protocol); partner and admin tokens start it with no status set, following the normal manual flow. Sending the same externalRef again does not create a second protocol — the existing one (including a since-deleted one) is returned with a 409, so retries are always safe.

Example:

{
    "testMode": true,
    "companyId": 1075,
    "sourceWarehouseId": 4,
    "destinationWarehouseId": 7,
    "protocolType": 1,
    "needCheck": false,
    "comments": "Transfer to Sofia",
    "receiver": "Store unit 2",
    "waybill": null,
    "instructions": null,
    "externalRef": "ERP-TRX-000123",
    "items": [
        { "refNumber": "4480541734500", "quantity": 1 },
        { "barcode": "449061657", "quantity": 1, "batchNo": "TRTEST01", "batchDate": "2028-10-31" },
        { "refNumber": "449067544700", "barcode": "4490675447", "quantity": 1, "batchNo": "TR3TEST01", "batchDate": "2028-05-31" }
    ]
}

API Response (Output Fields)

Field Description
protocolId ID of the created transfer protocol. null when testMode is true (validated, not saved), or when the request failed.
isConfirmed Reflects the token's access type: cabinet → 1 (STATUS_CABINET_WAITING); partner/admin → null.
protocolType Echoes the resolved protocol type (1 or 3; default 1).
itemsCreated Number of transfer detail lines created.
items Array with the resolved refNumber/barcode, quantity and batchId (null if no batch) actually written for each line.
error false on success, or the error identifier/text while executing the web service from the server-side.

Example:

{
  "protocolId": 98765,
  "isConfirmed": null,
  "protocolType": 1,
  "itemsCreated": 2,
  "items": [
    { "refNumber": "4480541734500", "quantity": 1, "batchId": null },
    { "barcode": "449061657", "quantity": 1, "batchId": 3979 }
  ],
  "error": false
}

Duplicate request (idempotency) — HTTP 409: Returned when the same externalRef already exists for this companyId (including a soft-deleted protocol, in which case isDeleted is true). No new protocol is created — the existing one is returned instead.

{
  "error": "DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_REF",
  "protocolId": 98765,
  "isConfirmed": null,
  "protocolType": 1,
  "externalRef": "ERP-TRX-000123",
  "isDeleted": false
}

Validation error — HTTP 422: Nothing is persisted (all-or-nothing). Structural/request-level problems come back under messages; per-row problems under itemErrors.

{
  "error": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "messages": [ "destination warehouse must differ from source" ],
  "itemErrors": [
    { "index": 0, "refNumber": "4480541734500", "error": "INSUFFICIENT_QUANTITY", "available": 8, "requested": 12 },
    { "index": 1, "barcode": "449061657", "error": "PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND_FOR_CUSTOMER" }
  ]
}

Per-row error codes (itemErrors[].error): PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND_FOR_CUSTOMER (no product with that refNumber/barcode belongs to companyId), INSUFFICIENT_QUANTITY (requested qty exceeds item-level availability; includes available + requested), INSUFFICIENT_BATCH_QUANTITY (requested qty exceeds per-batch stock in the source warehouse, or the batch doesn't exist; includes available + requested).

Structural codes/messages (messages[]): INVALID_QUANTITY (quantity missing/zero/fractional/non-numeric), BATCH_INCOMPLETE (batchNo without batchDate or vice versa), PROTOCOL_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED (protocolType=2 requested by a non-admin token), "destination warehouse must differ from source", "company not accessible for this token".

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
201 The transfer protocol was created successfully.
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
409 Duplicate externalRef for this companyId — see "Duplicate request" above; the existing protocol is returned, no new one is created.
422 Validation failed — see "Validation error" above for the messages/itemErrors detail.
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

Environment URL

request.description:
We can now offer you the ability to ask for COD information directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "COD Information Web Service".

With this service, you can receive detailed COD information. In the "referenceNumber" URL segment, fill the value you sent in "referenceNumber" when creating the AWB. The value can be an order number, a product number or an invoice number.

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
check-cod-by-order/{referenceNumber} Receive COD amount and payout information for the shipment created with the given reference number.

Method: GET Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

API Call Input Fields URL query parameters

field type required restrictions description
testMode boolean yes If you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.

Example URLs:

Test: https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/check-cod-by-order/CCS-03207-CZ?testMode=1 Production: https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/check-cod-by-order/CCS-03207-CZ?testMode=0

API Response (Output Fields)

Field Description
awbNumber AWB number.
referenceNumber The value that you filled in "referenceNumber" when creating the AWB.
COD COD amount in the country currency.
payedNumber The number of the payment protocol with which euShipments paid out the COD to you. Null until the COD has been paid out.
payedDate The date on which the COD payout was made. Null until the COD has been paid out.

Example:

{
  "awbNumber": "40695693257",
  "referenceNumber": "CCS-03207-CZ",
  "COD": "2310.00",
  "payedNumber": 10793,
  "payedDate": "2019-05-20 13:40:51"
}

Important - not-found behavior: if no shipment matches the reference number, or the shipment was not created with your API token, the service does NOT return an HTTP error. It responds with HTTP 200 and an empty (null) body. Always check that the response body actually contains data before processing it.

Note: "payedNumber" and "payedDate" are null while the COD has not yet been paid out. A response with these two fields set to null therefore means "COD collected/registered but not paid out yet", not an error.

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 Returns result from the web service. Also returned with an empty (null) body when no data was found for the reference number (see the not-found behavior above).
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to ask for a phone call history directly from your company's software or website by taking advantage of "Phone Call History Web Service".

Requirements:

API Endpoint Description
check-actions/{AWBNumber} With this service, you can receive the call history from our call centre for the chosen shipment.

Method: GET Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

API Call Input Fields URL query parameters

field type required restrictions description
testMode boolean yes If you want to use the API only for tests set this field to true. Applies only to the production environment. On the test environment, all shipments save on test env.

Example URLs:

Test: https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/check-actions/64506083?testMode=1 Production: https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/check-actions/64506083?testMode=0

API Response (Output Fields)

Field Description
actions Array with the actions history of the chosen shipment, ordered by date ascending.
ID The ID of the call record.
ACTION The action that was taken after the call (see the list of possible values below).
COMMENT Comment of the person who contacted the recipient.
Date The date when the action record was created in our system. Records are returned in ascending order by this field.

Possible ACTION values:

ACTION Meaning
Return to us The recipient asked for the shipment to be returned to the sender.
Organise delivery A delivery (or re-delivery) was arranged with the recipient.
New address The recipient provided a new delivery address.
Not answers The recipient did not answer the phone call.
Destroy it The shipment is to be destroyed.
From Import The record was created automatically from an import.
Phone call A phone call was made (general contact record).
Specified data The recipient specified/confirmed data for the delivery.

Example:

{
  "actions": [
    {
      "ID": 22083,
      "ACTION": "Return to us",
      "COMMENT": "test",
      "Date": "2019-02-01 12:14:00"
    },
    {
      "ID": 22084,
      "ACTION": "Organise delivery",
      "COMMENT": "ttt",
      "Date": "2019-02-01 12:26:00"
    },
    {
      "ID": 22094,
      "ACTION": "Destroy it",
      "COMMENT": "test",
      "Date": "2019-02-01 15:34:00"
    }
  ]
}

Important - "no actions" behavior: if the AWB exists but has no phone call actions, the service responds with HTTP 200 and the following body (there is no "actions" field in this case):

{
    "error": "Not found actions to specified AWB!"
}

Do not rely only on the HTTP status code - always check whether the response body contains "actions" or "error".

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 Returns result from the web service. Also returned with {"error": "Not found actions to specified AWB!"} when the AWB has no phone call actions (see above).
400 Bad request.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
500 {"error": "Not found AWB!"} - the AWB number does not exist. Note: an unknown AWB currently returns HTTP 500 (not 404).
500 Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.

We can now offer you the ability to declare shipments you have physically expedited (handed over to the courier / shipped out) directly from your company's software, by taking advantage of the "Expedited Shipments Web Service".

Submit the AWB numbers you expedited during the day; each valid, own, non-final shipment gets the "Expedited" status as its current status, and a status-history entry recording who submitted it and when. Invalid, foreign or already-finalized numbers are reported per number, without blocking the rest of the list.

Requirements

API Endpoint Description
expedited-shipments Declare a list of AWB numbers as expedited (physically handed over/shipped) by the client.

Method: POST Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN

API Call Input Fields Body (JSON)

field type required restrictions description
awbNumbers array of strings yes 1 to 500 numbers per request; each number max 50 characters List of AWB numbers you physically expedited. Duplicate numbers in the same list are processed once; empty/blank entries are silently dropped.

Example:

{
    "awbNumbers": [
        "17502058804253",
        "458121566013",
        "3UW0K2X034483"
    ]
}

Example URLs:

Test: https://test-api.inout.bg/api/v1/expedited-shipments Production: https://api1.inout.bg/api/v1/expedited-shipments

API Response (Output Fields) - HTTP 200

The service returns one result entry per submitted AWB number - an invalid/foreign/finalized number does NOT block the rest of the list.

Field Description
success Always true on HTTP 200 (per-number outcomes are inside "results" below).
data.results Array with one entry per submitted AWB number.
results[].awbNumber The AWB number, as submitted.
results[].status Outcome for this number - see table below.
results[].message Human-readable detail. Present for every status except "expedited".
data.summary.total Number of distinct AWB numbers processed (after dedup/trim).
data.summary.expedited How many were newly marked as Expedited.
data.summary.skipped How many were not changed (already expedited/final/not found/error).

Per-number status values:

status Meaning
expedited The shipment was marked as Expedited.
already_expedited It was already Expedited - nothing was overwritten (safe to resend).
final_status The shipment is already in a final status (e.g. Delivered, Returned, Cancelled) - the status was NOT changed.
not_found The number does not exist, or does not belong to the submitting client (foreign shipments are intentionally reported the same way as unknown ones, to avoid revealing that a number exists).
error Temporary technical issue - resubmit this number.

Example:

{
    "success": true,
    "data": {
        "results": [
            { "awbNumber": "17502058804253", "status": "expedited" },
            { "awbNumber": "458121566013", "status": "already_expedited", "message": "The shipment is already marked as expedited." },
            { "awbNumber": "3UW0K2X034483", "status": "final_status", "message": "The shipment is already in a final status (Delivered) and cannot be marked as expedited." },
            { "awbNumber": "UNKNOWN123", "status": "not_found", "message": "AWB not found." }
        ],
        "summary": { "total": 4, "expedited": 1, "skipped": 3 }
    }
}

Notes:

  • Idempotent - resubmitting the same numbers does not create duplicate history entries.
  • Can be called any number of times per day - with the full daily manifest at once, or in batches.
  • The Expedited status is visible everywhere the current status is shown (reports, status history, get-status endpoints).
  • The status only flows one way (client to us) - it is never pushed back to the client's own store/e-commerce platform as a notification.

HTTP Errors:

Code Description
200 Request accepted - see "results" for the per-number outcome, including invalid/foreign/finalized numbers.
400 {"error": "The awbNumbers list is required."} / {"error": "awbNumbers must be an array of AWB numbers."} / {"error": "Maximum 500 AWB numbers per request."} - malformed body.
401 Unauthenticated. API expects a header like - 'Authorization: Bearer (api_token)'.
500 {"success": false, "error": {"code": "STATUS_NOT_CONFIGURED", ...}} - the Expedited status is not yet configured in the system (see IN-4878). / Internal Server Error / This action is unauthorized.
